caption: The drawing depicts a tall rectangular wooden clock case with a detailed and realistic appearance rendered in brown tones. The clock is divided into three main sections arranged vertically. The upper section contains a circular clock face featuring black Roman numerals, two black clock hands, and floral decoration in the four corners of the square panel around the clock face, with pink and yellow tones. The middle section is a square and displays a black-and-white illustration of two people, possibly women, sitting outdoors next to a large ornamental urn, with trees and shrubbery in the background. The lower section is another square panel framed in wood, containing a colored scene of houses, a bridge, and trees, with a yellow sky and mountainous background, bordered by a decorative arch motif in light brown and gold. The entire case is bordered by prominent wooden columns on both sides and has ornate molding at the top and bottom. The drawing is signed "W. W. Jennings" in small, black capital letters near the bottom right. The overall composition sits against a plain, light beige background.
title: Clock
